high_level_description: This image features a pair of light blue woven flat shoes with cut-out patterns on the upper part, placed on a wooden floor. The shoes have ankle straps and appear to be new, as indicated by the tags attached to them. In the background, there is a decorative spinning wheel with various items inside, including what looks like small bags or pouches. The wheel has a teal color and is adorned with yellow dots along its rim. The text "Fizzy Goblet" is prominently displayed on the wheel, suggesting it might be a brand name or a store.
